snippet.title: OneBody Together – Official Trailer | Co-op Party Game Coming to Steam Nov 5
snippet.description:
One body. Up to 10 players. Total chaos.

OneBody Together is an online co-op party game where 3 to 10 players on a team share control of a single character. Every player claims a different role, and the team has to work together just to move, jump and fight as one. Two teams face off, and only the best-coordinated body wins.

🎮 GAME MODES
• Arena – timed PvP battle, the team with the most kills wins
• Parkour – race the rival team to the finish line (and kick them off the course)
• Keg Delivery – carry the keg to the enemy base, but the carrier can't fight

✨ FEATURES
• 3–10 players per team, 2 teams, one shared body each
• Troll pickups that lock or shuffle the enemy team's roles
• Play with friends via Steam invites, private lobbies and room codes
• Steam achievements
• 26 languages

📅 Release: November 5, 2026
🛒 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4999280
🆓 Free demo available on Steam

📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/onebodytogether
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/JGfZCjzeT4

Developed by Slaptula

—

🇹🇷 OneBody Together, her takımda 3–10 oyuncunun tek bir karakteri birlikte yönettiği online co-op parti oyunu. Herkes bir rol seçiyor ve karakterin hareket edip savaşabilmesi için takımın uyum içinde çalışması gerekiyor. 5 Kasım 2026'da Steam'de! İstek listene ekle, demoyu ücretsiz dene.

#OneBodyTogether #CoopGame #PartyGame #IndieGame #Steam
